bugs.title: Pressure conversion omits 500 mV zero offset
bugs.description: millivoltsToKpa() at line 25 divides the raw millivolt value by MV_PER_KPA without subtracting the 500 mV zero offset, so every reading is inflated by 50 kPa. The measured evidence shows printed 84.1 kPa while injected was 26.1 to 34.8 kPa (off by 49.3 kPa), and printed 127.1 kPa while injected was 62.2 to 77.5 kPa (off by 49.6 kPa), consistent with the missing (mv - 500) term. Firmware printed 84.1 kPa at 2.01 s while the injected input was 26.08 to 34.75 kPa: off by 49.3 kPa (tolerance ±2). 11 of 11 values were wrong.
